caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench-like chair with two seats, each with a separate backrest and three posts at the top of the back. The frame of the chair is painted in a reddish color, including all the legs, backrests, and arms. The seating surface consists of a woven material in a light tan or beige color, stretching across both sitting areas. Each backrest has two horizontal slats, and there are horizontal supports connecting the legs for added stability. The top of each corner post is rounded, finishing in a knob-like shape. The drawing is composed against a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Wagon Seat
